rules.rule: Coverage judged per function from its own Test_Foo family only
must: coverage is per-function, from direct tests only
Coverage it picks up from other functions' tests, `-coverpkg`, or a whole-suite run does not count

rules.rule: Writes limited to *_test.go; never add a production seam
must: `\*_test\.go`, which is the whole of this skill's write scope
Adding one is an API change, not a test

rules.rule: Never start function B before A is complete and verified
must: Never start function B until function A's loop is complete and verified

rules.rule: Measure with go test -run isolated family into per-function profiles
must: go test -run '\^Test_Foo\(\$\|_\)'
Keep each function's profiles rather than overwriting one scratch file

rules.rule: File/package/module plan-first and wait for approval; func/line run straight
must: Run straight \(no plan gate\), then report
Wait for approval, then run steps 3–4 function by function

rules.rule: max_tests is a hard cap counted per row/subtest
must: `max_tests=N` — hard cap on cases added this run

rules.rule: Complex deferred, un-coverable never attempted; documented panic is easy
must: un-coverable — one of the categories below. Never attempt
A \*documented\* panic is a contract

rules.rule: End of run: gofmt -l and go test -v -race on edited packages
must: Run `gofmt -l` on every edited `\*_test\.go` file
Run `go test -v -race` over every package this run edited

rules.rule: Tests obey go:style Test and inherited Production rules
must: obey it in every test written
Test does not replace Production, it adds to it

rules.rule: Report counts and every skipped line; never skip silently
must: Never skip a line silently
Report the count on every run, capped or not

rules.rule: Under fanout the max_tests cap is divided before dispatch and never exceeded; a zero share gets no worker
must: The cap wins over coverage
a package whose share is 0 gets no\s+worker
any share left unused goes, in one\s+follow-up dispatch, to packages that still have easy lines

rules.rule: The per-function loop ends at max_tests; a fixed case replaces the one it fixes
must: or `max_tests` is reached
A fixed case replaces the one\s+it fixes and does not count again
